frames.name: LSRK (kinematic LSR)
frames.desc: Standard solar motion: 20 km/s toward α = 18ʰ, δ = +30° (B1900) ⇒ (l, b) = (56.157°, 22.765°); radio-astronomy / FITS LSRK convention
frames.ref: Gordon 1976; Greisen et al. 2006 (FITS LSRK); astropy LSRK

frames.name: LSRD (dynamical, Delhaye 1965)
frames.desc: (U, V, W) = (9, 12, 7) km/s (FITS LSRD; astropy LSRD)

frames.name: Galactocentric (astropy v4.0 defaults)
frames.desc: v⊙ = (12.9, 245.6, 7.78) km/s in Galactocentric axes = (12.880, 245.600, 7.813) km/s on Galactic axes (Drimmel & Poggio 2018; R₀ = 8.122 kpc, z⊙ = 20.8 pc)
frames.ref: Drimmel & Poggio 2018; GRAVITY Collaboration 2018; Reid & Brunthaler 2004; Bennett & Bovy 2019

frames.name: Galactocentric (Sgr A* proper motion × GRAVITY 2021 R₀)
frames.desc: v⊙ = (11.1, 251.49, 8.59) km/s: U from Schönrich et al. 2010, V and W from the Sgr A* proper motion (Reid & Brunthaler 2020) at R₀ = 8.275 kpc (derived combination)
frames.ref: Reid & Brunthaler 2020; GRAVITY Collaboration 2021; Schönrich et al. 2010

frames.name: GSR (IAU 1985 Θ₀ = 220 km/s + LSRD) = NED/RC3
frames.desc: Θ₀ = 220 km/s toward l = 90° plus Delhaye (9, 12, 7) ⇒ 232.3 km/s toward (87.8°, 1.7°)
frames.ref: Kerr & Lynden-Bell 1986; Delhaye 1965; de Vaucouleurs et al. 1991 (RC3); NED

frames.name: Local Group (Yahil, Tammann & Sandage 1977)
frames.desc: Δv = −79 cos l cos b + 296 sin l cos b − 36 sin b km/s
